reason: CodexAppServerConnection.run_turn in harnesses.py misread how Codex app-server turns end. An agentMessage over 200,000 characters (or a /goal run's joined answers) built a completed HarnessEvent that failed pydantic validation, so a finished turn was stored as interrupted with a raw ValidationError; completed messages (and _complete_owner's ChatMessage) are now bounded with a truncation marker and payload.message_truncated. A turn Codex marked failed after its final answer (for example an after_agent hook failure) threw the answer away; it now completes with that answer and shows the TurnError as a warning notice and payload.turn_error. Other failed turns raised HarnessProviderError, a transport error, so stream_turn killed the healthy Codex process and showed a dict repr; they now raise HarnessTurnFailedError(HarnessError) carrying error.message and codexErrorInfo, whose kind maps to the diagnostic reason stream_turn passes to reason_code_for and on to the SSE error frame (usageLimitExceeded quota_exhausted, serverOverloaded/response*/httpConnectionFailed dependency_unavailable and retryable, contextWindowExceeded invalid_input with a compaction hint, unauthorized authentication_failed). Plan-mode answers (a plan item, no agentMessage) were lost and item/plan/delta went through _acp_plan_entries as empty step lists; plan text now streams as answer text and the completed plan item is appended to (or becomes) the message. A whitespace-only trailing agentMessage replaced the real answer; it is ignored, and turn/completed.turn.items (final_answer over phase-less) is preferred when present. Usage reported only the last model request's tokenUsage.last; it is now the growth of the cumulative tokenUsage.total since a total-minus-last baseline, priced per increment, with context_used still from last.inputTokens. _acp_plan_entries now reads Codex TurnPlanStep.step, and consecutive agent messages are separated by a blank line in the live stream. tests/v3/test_codex_turn_outcomes.py (24 tests, all failing on origin/main) proves each case; one existing adapter test was updated because its completed plan item is now part of the answer, and the listed existing node ids exercise the changed completion, goal, usage, plan-entry and stream_turn failure paths.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through harnesses.py) does not drive a Codex app-server turn outcome, which needs a scripted Codex; the Python tests drive CodexAppServerConnection, HarnessRuntimeService and the chat stream API directly. test_harness_adapters.py, test_harnesses.py, test_diagnostic_guidance.py, test_harness_commands.py, test_harness_connection_state.py, test_harness_provider_subagents.py, test_approval_continuation.py, test_approval_handoff.py, test_diagnostics_api.py, test_chat_queue.py, test_chat_decisions.py, test_minimal_agent_instructions.py and the harness tests of test_api.py and test_browser_companion.py were run locally and pass but are not selected. No full suites.
